name: Fathom
description: AI, Research and Media-native: AI meeting notetaker that records, transcribes and summarizes calls, with a public REST API, webhooks, SDKs and an official MCP server.
access_notes: API keys are self-generated from the API Access section of user Settings on the Fathom website — no approval process. Fathom has a free plan and third-party review confirms API access is included on all plan tiers including free. OAuth 2.0 is offered for public integrations that other Fathom users install.
mcp_notes: Official MCP documented in the vendor developer hub (developers.fathom.ai/mcp-docs) with guides for ChatGPT and Claude connectors. Composio FATHOM toolkit exists (7 tools; OAuth2 and API key; Composio-managed app available).
uncertainty_notes: API surface is meeting-data-centric: list meetings/teams/users, get transcripts/summaries, request recording downloads, manage webhooks — reads plus webhook/download management rather than broad write operations. Free-tier API availability is asserted by a third-party review; official docs show no plan gate but do not explicitly enumerate plans.

evidence.note: 'All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area'; keys sent in X-Api-Key header.
Official docs index: quickstart ('Generate an API key and make your first call'), OAuth guide for public apps, TypeScript/Python SDKs, MCP docs (mcp-docs/index, chatgpt, claude), OpenAPI spec.
Webhooks configurable in Settings or via POST /webhooks; signature verification via SDK verify_webhook helper.
Composio FATHOM toolkit: OAuth2 + API key, 7 tools, 'Composio Managed App Available? Yes'.
Third-party review: 'API access is available on all plan tiers including the free plan... no developer approval process'; MCP server at api.fathom.ai/mcp.
